plugin.description:
ENEMY BESTIARY TRACKER
USAGE:
enemies show enemies hide
ROOM SCANNING:
Automatically uses "look in room" when entering rooms.
Only one automatic room listing is allowed to be in flight at once. Rapid room changes are coalesced so stale room-listing responses cannot pile up and leak into the main output.
The enemy window itself is cleared immediately on every room header.
RESPONSIVE LAYOUT:
Text scales with the width available inside each enemy card. Element/status lists wrap by word, reward payouts wrap by reward item, and two-column mode never changes the outer miniwindow width.
PLURAL NAME RESOLUTION:
Plural enemies may require an automatic abbreviated "l <abbr>" command to resolve their canonical singular name.
As of 4.15, those lookups have their own independent state.
If you move while one is still returning: - its response remains suppressed - it is marked stale - it does NOT block the next room scan - its result is discarded when its response finishes
There is NO movement-settle/debounce delay in this version.
POKEDEX MODEL:
Elemental information discovered through Peep is cached permanently.
Modular theme client: colours are supplied by UI_Theme_Controller v2.0 when available.

function CombatLookCondition( line )
local condition = line:match( "%[([^%]]+)%]%s*$" )
if condition then
condition = condition:lower()
if APPROX_HP[ condition ] then
return condition, APPROX_HP[ condition ]
end
end
return "perfect health", 100 end
function IsArticleOccupant(line) local article = line:match("^(%a+)%s+") return article == "A" or article == "An" or article == "The" end

local knownDescription = false for _, entry in ipairs(enemyResults) do if entry._roomDescription == description and not combatLookSeenRows[entry] then return entry end end for index, observed in ipairs(roomVisibleSnapshot) do if RoomDescriptionKey(observed.line) == description then knownDescription = true for _, entry in ipairs(enemyResults) do if entry._roomIndex == index and not combatLookSeenRows[entry] then return entry end end end end if knownDescription then return nil end local core = NormalizeEnemyName(line) local best, bestLength for _, entry in ipairs(enemyResults) do local key = NormalizeEnemyName(entry.name) if not combatLookSeenRows[entry] and key ~= "" and (core == key or core:sub(1, #key + 1) == key .. " ") and (not bestLength or #key > bestLength) then best, bestLength = entry, #key end end if best then return best end -- Retain physical-room indexing for prose that does not use the canonical -- name. Filtered scenery/NPCs have no tracker row at that physical index. for _, entry in ipairs(enemyResults) do if entry._roomIndex == physicalIndex and not combatLookSeenRows[entry] then return entry end end return nil end

return end

if combatLookCapturePhase == "description" then

return end

local articleOccupant = IsArticleOccupant(line)
if not recognisedCondition and not articleOccupant then

e.approxHP = pct

e._hpConditionObservationSerial = hpConditionObservationSerial
SafeInferenceCall( LearnHPMaxFromCondition, e, condition )
if rawCondition and APPROX_HP[ rawCondition:lower() ] then

function WrapLabelValue( font, label, value, maxWidth )
local lines = {} local words = {}
for w in ( value or "none" ):gmatch("%S+") do
table.insert( words, w )
end
if #words == 0 then
table.insert( lines, { prefix = label, text = "none" } )
return lines
end
local labelWidth = WindowTextWidth( Win, font, label )
local currentWords = {}
local currentWidth = labelWidth
for _, word in ipairs( words ) do
local wordWidth = WindowTextWidth( Win, font, word .. " " )
if currentWidth + wordWidth > maxWidth and #currentWords > 0 then
table.insert( lines, { prefix = (#lines == 0) and label or "",
text = table.concat( currentWords, " " ) } )
currentWords = {}
currentWidth = 0
end
table.insert( currentWords, word )
currentWidth = currentWidth + wordWidth
end
if #currentWords > 0 then
table.insert( lines, { prefix = (#lines == 0) and label or "",
text = table.concat( currentWords, " " ) } )
end
return lines
end

y = y + LINE_H - 1

end

function FindApproxHPEnemy( entityText ) local description = RoomDescriptionKey(entityText)
-- Same-name NPC/scenery guard. Reject excluded prose descriptions, but -- never reject an exact tracked species name such as "Sheep [hurt]". -- This keeps a decorative/NPC sheep from poisoning HP tracking for every -- real Sheep row in the room. if roomExcludedDescriptions[description] then local exactTrackedSpecies = false for _, entry in ipairs(enemyResults) do if NormalizeEnemyName(entry.name) == description then exactTrackedSpecies = true break end end if not exactTrackedSpecies then return nil end end
local knownDescription = false for _, entry in ipairs(enemyResults) do if entry._roomDescription == description and not entry._hpSeenThisPass then return entry end end for index, observed in ipairs(roomVisibleSnapshot) do if RoomDescriptionKey(observed.line) == description then knownDescription = true for _, entry in ipairs(enemyResults) do if entry._roomIndex == index and not entry._hpSeenThisPass then return entry end end end end if knownDescription then return nil end
-- Name fallback is deliberately prefix-based rather than an arbitrary -- substring search. Room descriptions conventionally begin with the -- entity name/article, while substring matching lets an unrelated NPC or -- sentence steal a row simply because it contains the species word. local core = description
for _, e in ipairs( enemyResults ) do
if not e._hpSeenThisPass then
local key = NormalizeEnemyName( e.name )
if key ~= "" and (core == key or core:sub(1, #key + 1) == key .. " ") then
return e
end
end
end
return nil end
function ApplyPendingHPObservations( preservePending )
if #enemyResults == 0 then return end
-- A condition line is a partial update, not a complete room snapshot. -- Initialize new rows only; absent observations must not heal survivors. -- Actual untagged occupants are handled by ApplyVisibleHPToEntry and -- OnCombatLookCapture, where a full-health observation is available. for _, e in ipairs(enemyResults) do if e.approxHP == nil then e.hpCondition = "perfect health" e.approxHP = 100 end end
if #pendingHPObservations == 0 then
return end
-------------------------------------------------- -- Start a fresh assignment pass. Duplicate enemies -- are filled in room-output order, one row at a time. --------------------------------------------------
for _, e in ipairs( enemyResults ) do
e._hpSeenThisPass = nil
end
local remaining = {}
for _, observation in ipairs( pendingHPObservations ) do
local e = FindApproxHPEnemy( observation.entityText )
if e then
e.hpCondition = observation.condition
e.approxHP = observation.pct
e._hpSeenThisPass = true
else
table.insert( remaining, observation )
end
end
if not preservePending then
pendingHPObservations = remaining
end end

-- Enemy names get their own responsive font and are fitted against the -- actual element-panel width so a long canonical name cannot cross into stats. local nameInner = math.max(40, ELEMENT_PANEL_WIDTH - (INSET * 2)) while NAME_FONT_SIZE > MIN_NAME_FONT_SIZE do WindowFont(Win, "name"..Win, FONT_NAME, NAME_FONT_SIZE, true) local widest = 0 for _, e in ipairs(enemyResults or {}) do local text = tostring(e.name or "") if e.consider and e.consider.rating and e.consider.rating ~= "" then text = text .. " (" .. tostring(e.consider.rating) .. ")" end widest = math.max(widest, WindowTextWidth(Win, "name"..Win, text)) end if widest <= nameInner then break end NAME_FONT_SIZE = NAME_FONT_SIZE - 1 end WindowFont(Win, "name"..Win, FONT_NAME, NAME_FONT_SIZE, true) end
-------------------------------------------------- -- RESIZE + COLUMN GEOMETRY --------------------------------------------------
function SaveEnemyWindowSize() SetVariable("enemy_window_width", tostring(math.floor(WINDOW_WIDTH))) SetVariable("enemy_window_height", tostring(math.floor(WINDOW_HEIGHT))) end
function EnemyColumnCount() return (#enemyResults > 3) and 2 or 1 end
function ApplyEnemyColumnGeometry(cardWidth) cardWidth = math.max(220, math.floor(cardWidth)) DIVIDER_WIDTH = math.max(6, math.floor(BASE_DIVIDER_WIDTH * math.min(1.25, cardWidth / BASE_WINDOW_WIDTH) + 0.5))
-- Every card consumes all of its available width. The element and stat -- regions are proportional instead of being capped at old fixed pixel sizes. STAT_SINGLE_COLUMN = cardWidth < 470 local statsRatio = STAT_SINGLE_COLUMN and 0.36 or 0.35 STATS_PANEL_WIDTH = math.max(100, math.floor(cardWidth * statsRatio)) ELEMENT_PANEL_WIDTH = math.max(110, cardWidth - DIVIDER_WIDTH - STATS_PANEL_WIDTH) end
function EnemyResizeMouseDown(flags, hotspot_id) resizeActive = true return 0 end
function UpdateEnemyResizeFromMouse() local mx,my=tonumber(WindowInfo(Win,17)),tonumber(WindowInfo(Win,18)) local left=tonumber(WindowInfo(Win,10)) or tonumber(WindowInfo(Win,1)) or 0 local top=tonumber(WindowInfo(Win,11)) or tonumber(WindowInfo(Win,2)) or 0 if not mx or not my then return false end local w=math.max(MIN_WINDOW_WIDTH,math.floor(mx-left+1)) local h=math.max(MIN_WINDOW_HEIGHT,math.floor(my-top+1)) if w == WINDOW_WIDTH and h == WINDOW_HEIGHT then return false end WINDOW_WIDTH,WINDOW_HEIGHT=w,h WindowResize(Win,w,h,BACKGROUND_COLOUR) Redraw() return true end
function EnemyResizeMouseMove(flags,hotspot_id) if resizeActive then UpdateEnemyResizeFromMouse() end SetCursor(miniwin.cursor_nw_se_arrow) return 0 end
function EnemyResizeMouseUp(flags,hotspot_id) if resizeActive then UpdateEnemyResizeFromMouse() end resizeActive=false SaveEnemyWindowSize() RenderEnemyWindow() return 0 end
function InstallEnemyResizeHandle(renderWidth, renderHeight) WindowDeleteHotspot(Win,"00_resize") WindowAddHotspot(Win,"00_resize",renderWidth-RESIZE_GRIP_SIZE,renderHeight-RESIZE_GRIP_SIZE,renderWidth,renderHeight, "","","EnemyResizeMouseDown","","","Drag to resize",miniwin.cursor_nw_se_arrow,0) WindowDragHandler(Win,"00_resize","EnemyResizeMouseMove","EnemyResizeMouseUp",0) WindowLine(Win,renderWidth-11,renderHeight-3,renderWidth-3,renderHeight-11,BORDER_COLOUR,miniwin.pen_solid,1) WindowLine(Win,renderWidth-7,renderHeight-3,renderWidth-3,renderHeight-7,BORDER_COLOUR,miniwin.pen_solid,1) end
function EnemyEntryMeasuredHeight(e,maxTextWidth) if e.scanned then return math.max(MeasureScannedEntryHeight(e,maxTextWidth), StatsPanelHeight(e, nil)+LINE_H+4) end local rewardLines = e.reward and KillRewardLineCount("body"..Win, e.reward, math.max(1, ELEMENT_PANEL_WIDTH-(INSET*2))) or 0 return UNSCANNED_HEIGHT + (e.approxHP and (HP_BAR_HEIGHT+HP_BAR_GAP) or 0) + (rewardLines * LINE_H) end
function DrawEnemyEntry(e,index,xOffset,y,cardWidth,maxTextWidth,isLastInColumn) local entryTop=y e.count=1
if not e.scanned then DrawEnemyNameLine(e,xOffset+INSET,y) y=y+LINE_H+1 y=DrawApproxHPBar(e,xOffset+INSET,y,xOffset+ELEMENT_PANEL_WIDTH-INSET) WindowText(Win,"body"..Win,"Not yet scanned - cast peep on it to reveal stats.",xOffset+INSET,y,0,0,UNSCANNED_COLOUR,false) y=y+LINE_H if e.reward then y=DrawKillRewardWrapped("body"..Win,e.reward,xOffset+INSET,y,xOffset+ELEMENT_PANEL_WIDTH-INSET,LINE_H) end y=y+6 else local scannedTop=y DrawEnemyNameLine(e,xOffset+INSET,y) y=y+LINE_H+2 y=DrawApproxHPBar(e,xOffset+INSET,y,xOffset+ELEMENT_PANEL_WIDTH-INSET) local elementalRows={{"Vuln: ",e.vulnerable,VULN_COLOUR},{"Resist: ",e.resistant,RESIST_COLOUR},{"Immune: ",e.immune,IMMUNE_COLOUR},{"Absorb: ",e.absorb,ABSORB_COLOUR}} for _,row in ipairs(elementalRows) do local value=row[2] if value and value~="" and value~="none" then y=DrawWrappedLines(xOffset+INSET,y,WrapLabelValue("body"..Win,row[1],value,maxTextWidth),LABEL_COLOUR,row[3],NONE_COLOUR) end end if e.other and e.other~="none" then y=DrawWrappedLines(xOffset+INSET,y,WrapLabelValue("body"..Win,"Other: ",e.other,maxTextWidth),LABEL_COLOUR,LABEL_COLOUR,NONE_COLOUR) end local leftBottom=y+4 local statsBottom=scannedTop+StatsPanelHeight(e,cardWidth)+LINE_H+4 DrawStatsPanel(e,scannedTop,math.max(leftBottom,statsBottom),xOffset,cardWidth) y=math.max(leftBottom,statsBottom) end
local hotspot_id="enemy_peep_"..tostring(index) enemyHotspots[hotspot_id]=e.name WindowAddHotspot(Win,hotspot_id,xOffset,entryTop,xOffset+cardWidth,y,"","","","","PeepEnemyFromHotspot","Cast Peep on "..e.name,miniwin.cursor_hand,0) if not isLastInColumn then WindowRectOp(Win,miniwin.rect_fill,xOffset+INSET,y-3,xOffset+ELEMENT_PANEL_WIDTH-INSET,y-2,SEPARATOR_COLOUR) end return y end
-------------------------------------------------- -- RENDER WINDOW --------------------------------------------------
function RenderEnemyWindow()
ClearEnemyHotspots()
if type(windowinfo) ~= "table" then windowinfo=movewindow.install(Win,miniwin.pos_bottom_right,miniwin.create_absolute_location,true) end
local columnCount=EnemyColumnCount() -- Column mode NEVER changes the outer width. The player's current/saved -- width is authoritative; only the contents reflow and scale. WINDOW_WIDTH=math.max(MIN_WINDOW_WIDTH,math.floor(WINDOW_WIDTH or MIN_WINDOW_WIDTH)) WINDOW_HEIGHT=math.max(MIN_WINDOW_HEIGHT,math.floor(WINDOW_HEIGHT or MIN_WINDOW_HEIGHT)) local cardWidth=math.floor((WINDOW_WIDTH-((columnCount-1)*ENEMY_COLUMN_GAP))/columnCount) ApplyEnemyColumnGeometry(cardWidth) ApplyEnemyDensity(cardWidth,columnCount)
check(WindowCreate(Win,windowinfo.window_left,windowinfo.window_top,WINDOW_WIDTH,TITLE_HEIGHT+20,windowinfo.window_mode,windowinfo.window_flags,BACKGROUND_COLOUR)) check(WindowFont(Win,"body"..Win,FONT_NAME,FONT_SIZE)) check(WindowFont(Win,"stats"..Win,FONT_NAME,STAT_FONT_SIZE)) check(WindowFont(Win,"name"..Win,FONT_NAME,NAME_FONT_SIZE,true)) check(WindowFont(Win,"title"..Win,FONT_NAME,9,true)) FitResponsiveFontsToPanels()
local maxTextWidth=ELEMENT_PANEL_WIDTH-(INSET*2) local rowsPerColumn=(columnCount==2) and math.ceil(#enemyResults/2) or math.max(1,#enemyResults) local columnHeights={0,0} if #enemyResults==0 then columnHeights[1]=ENTRY_HEIGHT else for i,e in ipairs(enemyResults) do local col=(columnCount==2 and i>rowsPerColumn) and 2 or 1 columnHeights[col]=columnHeights[col]+EnemyEntryMeasuredHeight(e,maxTextWidth) end end local contentHeight=math.max(columnHeights[1] or 0,columnHeights[2] or 0) local renderHeight=math.max(WINDOW_HEIGHT,TITLE_HEIGHT+contentHeight+6)
check(WindowCreate(Win,windowinfo.window_left,windowinfo.window_top,WINDOW_WIDTH,renderHeight,windowinfo.window_mode,windowinfo.window_flags,BACKGROUND_COLOUR)) WindowRectOp(Win,miniwin.rect_fill,0,0,WINDOW_WIDTH,renderHeight,BACKGROUND_COLOUR) WindowRectOp(Win,miniwin.rect_frame,0,0,WINDOW_WIDTH,renderHeight,BORDER_COLOUR) WindowRectOp(Win,miniwin.rect_fill,0,0,WINDOW_WIDTH,TITLE_HEIGHT,TITLE_BAR_COLOUR) WindowText(Win,"title"..Win,"ROOM ENEMIES",8,4,0,0,TITLE_COLOUR,false)
if columnCount==2 then local columnDivider=cardWidth+math.floor(ENEMY_COLUMN_GAP/2) WindowLine(Win,columnDivider,TITLE_HEIGHT,columnDivider,renderHeight,SEPARATOR_COLOUR,miniwin.pen_solid,1) end
for col=1,columnCount do local xOffset=(col-1)*(cardWidth+ENEMY_COLUMN_GAP) local dividerX=xOffset+ELEMENT_PANEL_WIDTH+math.floor(DIVIDER_WIDTH/2) WindowRectOp(Win,miniwin.rect_fill,xOffset+ELEMENT_PANEL_WIDTH,TITLE_HEIGHT,xOffset+ELEMENT_PANEL_WIDTH+DIVIDER_WIDTH,renderHeight,TITLE_BAR_COLOUR) WindowLine(Win,dividerX,TITLE_HEIGHT,dividerX,renderHeight,SEPARATOR_COLOUR,miniwin.pen_solid,1) end
if #enemyResults==0 then WindowText(Win,"body"..Win,"No enemies detected.",INSET,TITLE_HEIGHT+8,0,0,LABEL_COLOUR,false) else local y={TITLE_HEIGHT+4,TITLE_HEIGHT+4} for i,e in ipairs(enemyResults) do local col=(columnCount==2 and i>rowsPerColumn) and 2 or 1 local xOffset=(col-1)*(cardWidth+ENEMY_COLUMN_GAP) local lastIndex=(col==1) and math.min(rowsPerColumn,#enemyResults) or #enemyResults y[col]=DrawEnemyEntry(e,i,xOffset,y[col],cardWidth,maxTextWidth,i==lastIndex) end end
movewindow.add_drag_handler(Win,0,0,0,TITLE_HEIGHT) InstallEnemyResizeHandle(WINDOW_WIDTH,renderHeight) WindowShow(Win,enemyWindowVisible) Redraw() end

function ManagedLayoutParse(spec) local windowName, sx, sy, sw, sh = tostring(spec or ""):match("^([^\t]+)\t(-?%d+)\t(-?%d+)\t(%d+)\t(%d+)$") if not windowName then return nil end return windowName, tonumber(sx), tonumber(sy), tonumber(sw), tonumber(sh) end
function ManagedLayoutSetMoveWindowInfo(info, winName, x, y) if type(info) ~= "table" then return end info.window_left = x info.window_top = y info.window_mode = tonumber(WindowInfo(winName, 7)) or info.window_mode or miniwin.pos_top_left info.window_flags = tonumber(WindowInfo(winName, 8)) or info.window_flags or miniwin.create_absolute_location end
function GetManagedLayoutWindows() return Win end
function ApplyManagedLayout(spec) local windowName, x, y, w, h = ManagedLayoutParse(spec) if windowName ~= Win then return "wrong window" end
WINDOW_WIDTH = math.max(MIN_WINDOW_WIDTH, math.floor(w)) WINDOW_HEIGHT = math.max(MIN_WINDOW_HEIGHT, math.floor(h)) SaveEnemyWindowSize()
WindowResize( Win, WINDOW_WIDTH, WINDOW_HEIGHT, BACKGROUND_COLOUR )
ManagedLayoutSetMoveWindowInfo(windowinfo, Win, x, y) RenderEnemyWindow()
local mode = type(windowinfo) == "table" and windowinfo.window_mode or miniwin.pos_top_left local flags = type(windowinfo) == "table" and windowinfo.window_flags or miniwin.create_absolute_location WindowPosition(Win, x, y, mode, flags) if movewindow then movewindow.save_state(Win) end pcall(SaveState) Redraw() return "ok" end
